notes.notes:

The fix was delayed due to PC issues. It seems my development PC became cursed. After performing an exorcism, I successfully fixed the bugs.

notes.title: Notice of Known Issue (Ver.1.0.3)
notes.notes:
We are currently aware of the following issue. Due to PC problems, it may take some time to implement a fix.

■ Known Issue
If you open "Settings" on the title screen and return to the title screen using the "Return to Title" button, you will be unable to control the game when it starts.

■ Workaround
If you lose control: Please exit and restart the game.
When opening settings on the title screen: Please close the settings screen using the "Close" button.
